adjective_to_adverb.rule: Given an adjective, output the corresponding -ly adverb.

adjective_to_noun.rule: Derived adjective -> its base noun (strip -ous/-al/-ic/-ful/-less/-ive etc.).

adverb_to_adjective.rule: Given an -ly adverb, output the adjective it is derived from.

agent_noun.rule: Given a verb, output the agent noun formed with -er/-or (the person or thing that does the action).

agent_noun_to_verb.rule: Given an -er/-or agent noun, output the verb it is derived from.

alphabet_position_first_letter.rule: Word (first letter restricted to a-j) -> the alphabet position (1-10) of its first letter.

animal_class.rule: Given an animal, output its taxonomic class from the fixed set {mammal, bird, fish, reptile, insect}.

animal_plant_object.rule: Classify a concrete noun as animal, plant, or object.

article_choice.rule: Given a singular noun, output the correct indefinite article, 'a' or 'an', determined by the noun's initial sound.

case_of_word.rule: Word shown either ALL-CAPS or all-lowercase -> the label 'upper' or 'lower'.

city-continent.rule: Given a well-known world city, output its continent (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, or Australia).

city-country.rule: Given a well-known world city, output the country it is in.

compound_first.rule: Given a closed compound noun, output its first constituent word (the modifier).

compound_head.rule: Given a closed compound noun, output its head — the final constituent word.

compound_join.rule: Given two words that form a standard closed compound, output the compound written as one word.

concrete_abstract.rule: Classify a noun as concrete (a physical thing you can see or touch) or abstract (an idea, quality, or state).

contains_letter_e.rule: Word -> 'yes' if the letter e occurs anywhere in it, else 'no'.

count_digits.rule: Given a positive integer written in digits, output how many digits it has.

count_letter_e.rule: Word -> how many times the letter e occurs in it (0-3).

count_words.rule: Phrase of 1-4 space-separated words -> the number of words.

count_zeros.rule: Given a digit string, output how many of its digits are '0'.

countable_uncountable.rule: Given an English noun, output countable if it takes a plural and numerals naturally, or uncountable if it is a mass noun.

day_after_textual_date.rule: Given a date like 'March 5, 1984' with day 1-27, output the month and next day: 'March 6'.

days_in_month.rule: Given 'MonthName Year' where the month is not February, output the number of days in that month (30 or 31).

double_last_letter.rule: Word -> the word with its final letter written twice.

double_no_carry.rule: Given an integer all of whose digits are 4 or less, output its double.

double_word.rule: Word -> the word written twice, space-separated.

ends_with_ing.rule: Word -> 'yes' if it ends with the letters 'ing', else 'no'.

ends_with_vowel.rule: Word -> 'vowel' if its last letter is one of a,e,i,o,u, else 'consonant'.

english-dutch.rule: Translate a common English word into its most common single-word Dutch equivalent.

english-italian.rule: Translate a common English word into its most common single-word Italian equivalent.

english-portuguese.rule: Translate a common English word into its most common single-word Portuguese equivalent.

first_digit.rule: Given a positive integer written in digits, output its first (leftmost) digit.

first_letter_second_word.rule: Two-word phrase -> the first letter of the SECOND word, lowercase.

first_three_letters.rule: Word -> its first three letters, lowercase.

first_two_letters.rule: Word -> its first two letters, lowercase.

first_vowel.rule: Word -> the first vowel (a,e,i,o,u) reading left to right.

french-english.rule: Translate a common French word into its most common single-word English equivalent.

french_noun_gender.rule: Given a common French noun, output its grammatical gender: masculine or feminine.

german-english.rule: Translate a common German word into its most common single-word English equivalent.

german_noun_gender.rule: Given a common German noun, output its definite article: der, die, or das.

gerund_to_base.rule: Given a verb's -ing form, output its base (infinitive) form.

gerund_to_past.rule: Given a verb's -ing form, output the same verb's past tense.

hour_after_time.rule: Given a 24-hour clock time HH:MM with hour 00-22, output the time one hour later (minutes unchanged).

hypernym_category.rule: Given a common noun, output its superordinate category from a fixed set of 18 labels (beverage, bird, building, clothing, fabric, fish, flower, fruit, furniture, instrument, metal, profession, sport, tool, tree, vegetable, vehicle, weapon).

initials_two_words.rule: Two-word phrase -> the two initials, uppercased and concatenated.

iso_date_to_month.rule: Given a date in YYYY-MM-DD format, output the English name of its month.

iso_date_year_plus_one.rule: Given a date in YYYY-MM-DD format, output the year one greater than the date's year.

language_identification.rule: Given a common word from French, Spanish, German, or Italian, output the name of the language it belongs to.

larger_of_pair.rule: Given two distinct integers separated by a space, output the larger one.

larger_than_1000.rule: Given an integer other than 1000, output 'yes' if it is greater than 1000, otherwise 'no'.

largest_digit.rule: Given a positive integer written in digits, output its largest digit.

last_digit.rule: Given a positive integer written in digits, output its last (rightmost) digit.

last_two_letters.rule: Word -> its last two letters, lowercase.

last_vowel.rule: Word -> the last vowel (a,e,i,o,u) reading right to left.

living_nonliving.rule: Classify a concrete noun as living (organism: animal, plant, or person) or nonliving.

lowercase_word.rule: Fully uppercased word -> the same word fully lowercased.

minus_ten.rule: Given an integer >= 20 whose tens digit is not 0, output that integer minus 10.

nato_first_letter.rule: Word -> the NATO phonetic-alphabet codeword for its first letter (e.g. c -> Charlie).

natural_manmade.rule: Classify a concrete noun as naturally occurring (natural) or made by humans (manmade).

next_letter_of_last_letter.rule: Word -> the alphabet successor of its LAST letter, uppercased.

next_month_of_date.rule: Given 'MonthName Year', output the name of the following month (December -> January).

noun_possessive.rule: Given a singular noun, output its possessive form (noun + 's).

number_word_to_digits.rule: Given a number spelled out in English words (21-1500), output it in digits.

ordinal_suffix.rule: Given an integer in digits, output the same integer with its English ordinal suffix attached (21 -> 21st, 112 -> 112th).

parity_even_odd.rule: Given an integer, output 'even' if it is even and 'odd' if it is odd.

past_to_base.rule: Given a verb in past tense, output its base (infinitive) form.

percent_to_decimal.rule: Given a percentage 'N%' where N is an integer not divisible by 10, output N/100 as a decimal.

person_place_thing.rule: Classify a noun as person (a human or human role), place (a location), or thing (a physical object).

plural_to_singular.rule: Given a plural noun, output its singular form.

plus_hundred.rule: Given an integer whose hundreds digit is not 9, output that integer plus 100.

plus_ten.rule: Given an integer whose tens digit is not 9, output that integer plus 10.

pos_label.rule: Given a word with only one part of speech, output that part of speech (noun, verb, adjective, or adverb).

prev_capital_letter.rule: Word -> the alphabet predecessor of its first letter, uppercased.

remove_first_letter.rule: Word -> the word with its first letter deleted.

remove_last_letter.rule: Word -> the word with its last letter deleted.

round_down_to_hundred.rule: Given an integer >= 101 that is not a multiple of 100, output it rounded down to the nearest multiple of 100.

round_up_to_ten.rule: Given an integer that is not a multiple of 10, output it rounded up to the next multiple of 10.

second_digit.rule: Given a positive integer with at least two digits, output its second digit from the left.

singular_or_plural.rule: Given a noun form, output singular or plural.

smaller_of_pair.rule: Given two distinct integers separated by a space, output the smaller one.

spanish-english.rule: Translate a common Spanish word into its most common single-word English equivalent.

spanish_noun_gender.rule: Given a common Spanish noun, output its grammatical gender: masculine or feminine.

starts_with_vowel.rule: Word -> 'vowel' if its first letter is one of a,e,i,o,u, else 'consonant'.

strip_prefix.rule: Given a word formed with a derivational prefix (un-, re-, dis-, mis-, non-, over-, under-, pre-), output the base word with the prefix removed.

third_person_to_base.rule: Given a verb's third-person singular present (-s) form, output its base form.

time_to_minutes.rule: 24h clock time HH:MM -> total minutes since midnight (h*60+m).

titlecase_phrase.rule: Two-word lowercase phrase -> the phrase with each word capitalized.

uppercase_word.rule: Lowercase word -> the same word fully uppercased.

us-city-state.rule: Given a well-known US city, output the US state it is in.

verb_tense_label.rule: Given an inflected verb form, output which inflection it is: past, gerund, or present (third-person -s).

verb_to_gerund.rule: Given a verb in base form, output its gerund/present-participle (-ing) form.

verb_to_third_person.rule: Given a verb in base form, output its third-person singular present (-s) form.

word_polarity.rule: Given a strongly evaluative English word, output whether its connotation is positive or negative.

year_to_decade.rule: Given a four-digit year, output its decade in the standard 'YYY0s' form (1987 -> 1980s).
